title: Emergency Fund: How Much Is Enough, Really? (Find Your Number)

lines.say: How big should your emergency fund be?
Not the internet's number. Yours.
First, what it's for. Losing your job. A medical bill. A car that won't start.
Not the holidays, or car registration. Those are on the calendar, so they belong in sinking funds. That's episode three.
So let's find your number, in three steps.
Step one. Count essentials, not income.
If your income stopped tomorrow, what would you still have to pay? Here's our example from episode one.

lines.cap: That's $3,011 a month. Fun money, streaming and eating out don't count. You'd cut those first.
lines.say: That's three thousand and eleven a month. Fun money, streaming and eating out don't count. You'd cut those first.
Step two. Pick how many months.

scene.head: LEAN TOWARD 6 MONTHS IF…
items: Your job is hard to replace

lines.say: The usual range is three to six months of essentials.
Lean toward six if your income is irregular, you're the only earner, you have kids, or your job would be hard to replace.

lines.cap: For our example, 3 months is $9,033. Six months is about $18,000.
lines.say: For our example, three months is nine thousand and thirty-three. Six months is about eighteen thousand.
Step three. Build it in stages, so it never feels impossible.

rows.label: 3 months · $453/mo + two extra paychecks a year

lines.cap: Start with a starter goal: one month of bills, $2,371. At $453 a month (the money freed up once the credit card is gone), that's 6 months.
lines.say: Start with a starter goal: one month of bills, twenty-three seventy-one. At four fifty-three a month, the money freed up once the credit card is gone, that's six months.
Three full months at that pace takes twenty months.
But send your two three-paycheck-month checks there too, and it's about a year.

scene.text: Keep it boring: a separate high-yield savings account.

lines.say: Keep it somewhere boring. A separate high-yield savings account, ideally at a different bank. Easy to reach in an emergency, but not so easy you spend it on a Tuesday.

scene.text: Used it? Refill it. That's the system working.

lines.say: And if you use it, that's what it's for. Pause the extras, refill it, then get back to your goals.
